output:
Hiya Mum, Kirsty and Linda,

Right, I’ve got a plan for Gran’s 80th and I’m absolutely buzzing about it, so this is top secret — no letting anything slip to Gran!

Her birthday’s on Sunday 13 December, but we’re celebrating on the Saturday. Morag has very kindly said I can have Hair by Morag on Dumbarton Road to myself on Saturday 12 December from 1pm. She closes at 12 on a Saturday, so we’ll have the whole place to ourselves for the afternoon.

I want to do everyone’s hair for free before we head out for dinner. That’s me, Mum, Kirsty, Linda, Gran, Ava and Ruby — seven heads altogether. Cuts and blow-dries are no bother, but if you want a colour, I need you to tell me exactly what you’re after by Friday 27 November so I can get everything ordered in from the wholesaler. If I don’t hear back in time, it’ll be a cut and blow-dry only, so don’t leave it till the last minute!

I’m especially hoping to do Gran’s hair silver properly. She said at Easter that she’d love to do it but won’t pay salon prices, so I’d love to surprise her and get it done as part of her birthday. Mum, you’re probably the best bet for getting her to the salon for 1pm without telling her why — can you work your magic?

Ava and Ruby can have wee braids and glitter spray, which I’m sure they’ll love. And Linda, you’ll be pleased to hear your cooker and the dog are safe this time, since we’re not doing your colour in your kitchen!

Dinner’s booked for 8.30pm that night at the Italian place on Byres Road. The table’s for nine, including Uncle Davie and Kirsty’s man.

Bring a bottle of fizz if you fancy it. Morag’s happy for us to have a drink as long as we tidy up after ourselves.

So, message me back with what you want done, especially any colours, by Friday 27 November. Can’t wait — it’s going to be a brilliant day!

Love,  
[Your name] xx
